snippet.title: Whitaker Smoke & Freight
snippet.description:
BBQ, smoking, and straight talk on the freight business from a Knoxville pitmaster and broker. Ribs, brisket, pulled pork, plus carrier tips and a little Appalachian history. New videos most weeks.

Topics: Offset smoking, rubs and sauces, brisket and ribs, freight brokering basics, carrier vetting, and Tennessee BBQ road trips.

Business inquiries: floyd.whitaker@Finthesiss.ai
